body:
- Relative `src=./foo.csv` → goes through `AssetResolver.resolve()`.
  Works when opened via FSA folder or dropped folder (with persistent
  handles).
- Absolute `src=https://host/foo.csv` → fetched directly. Manifest
  `host_permissions: ["<all_urls>"]` bypasses CORS (chose Option A
  over `optional_host_permissions` for v0.1 UX; migration plan in
  `docsi/DATAGRID.md` §CORS).

---
